data.name: Jyotsnavi
data.gender_notes: Jyotsnavi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jyotsna means 'knowledge' or 'light' in Sanskrit. The suffix vi denotes the feminine gender, making Jyotsnavi the Goddess of Knowledge and Learning. In Hindu mythology, Jyotsnavi is considered the goddess of wisdom and knowledge. The name Jyotsnavi carries the meaning “Goddess of Knowledge and Learning” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jyotsnavi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and learning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jyotsnavi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Knowledge and Learning.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jyotsnavi total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

The influence of this name extends to various aspects of Indian society, from education and literature to art, music and dance. In India, the goddess of knowledge is often depicted with a lamp, podium, or books.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Jyotsnavi holds immense significance for those who seek knowledge and wisdom. It is believed that invoking the name Jyotsnavi brings enlightenment and clarity of mind. The goddess is seen as a guiding light in the pursuit of spiritual growth and personal development. She bestows the gift of knowledge and helps us understand the deeper meanings of life. In essence, Jyotsnavi represents the inner light of wisdom and the external source of knowledge, inspiring us to expand our minds and explore the vast expanse of human knowledge.
